changelog: Introducing jedRAMChecker for real-time physical memory footprint monitoring, Mach kernel pressure tracking, live allocation graphs, and Increased Memory Limit entitlement checks. This release also upgrades jedBenchmark 2 with dynamic memory headroom tracking to prevent jetsam terminations, updates jedPhoneInfo with kernel RAM metrics, and completes core architecture cleanups by removing legacy framework labels. This update is recommended for all users.
